races.name: Weatherbys nhstallions.co.uk Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Snatch A Glance
runners_data.note: Excellent recent form with five straight good going runs showing 2 wins from 5 starts

runners_data.name: Current Edition
runners_data.note: Limited recent exposure with only two soft ground runs to assess current ability

runners_data.name: Jimbo Sport
runners_data.note: Proven front-runner with strong good going record showing 1 win from 4 similar surface starts

runners_data.name: Kenobi
runners_data.note: Question mark over current form with recent efforts on softer ground

runners_data.name: Scarlet Moon
runners_data.note: Consistent performer but needs to prove effectiveness on faster surface having raced mainly on soft

runners_data.name: King's Scholar
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who showed best form when winning on good ground last time out

runners_data.name: Josh Central
runners_data.note: Outclassed on ratings with poor recent form showing no wins from similar going experience

runners_data.name: Golden Garden
runners_data.note: Solid good going record but significantly lower rating than main rivals

races.paceDynamic: Jimbo Sport will dictate a measured gallop from the front with no other confirmed leaders in this field. The prominent runners Current Edition, Kenobi, Scarlet Moon and Josh Central will track behind, setting up a tactical finish where hold-up horses Snatch A Glance and King's Scholar can time their challenges from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Jimbo Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Jimbo Sport gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The proven front-runner utilizes his tactical advantage to repel late challenges. Hold-up horses struggle to peg back the strong pace-setter.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Tells
scenarios.trigger: If Current Edition and Scarlet Moon press Jimbo Sport from the home turn
scenarios.body: The sustained pressure up front creates a true gallop that finds out stamina reserves. The strongest stayer prevails in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and kick comes late
scenarios.body: Snatch A Glance and King's Scholar benefit from the patient ride to produce telling late surges. Their fresh legs overcome the prominent pack.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites fail to fire and race opens up
scenarios.body: Kenobi or Golden Garden capitalizes on others' misfortunes to grab an unlikely victory. The outsiders benefit from reduced expectations and tactical freedom.

watchPoints.text: Jimbo Sport getting a soft lead could prove decisive given his front-running style and tactical advantage
Current Edition's fitness levels after limited recent outings on different going conditions
Scarlet Moon adapting from predominantly soft ground form to today's good surface
King's Scholar timing his challenge from the back given his hold-up running style
Golden Garden potentially overperforming his modest rating if pace collapses up front

races.name: G.C.Rickards Mares' Handicap Chase (Queen Boudicca Mares' Chase Series Qualifier)

runners_data.name: Annie Express
runners_data.note: Highest-rated runner but recent form is concerning with three consecutive defeats including a fall

runners_data.name: A Little Something
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer who has placed four times from ten runs on similar going

runners_data.name: Kit's Coty
runners_data.note: Won last time out at this trip on good going and proven prominent runner on this surface

runners_data.name: Moonlightinthepark
runners_data.note: Limited experience on good going with only one run at this condition

runners_data.name: Wishful Wings
runners_data.note: Proven fader in the finish which could be problematic over this staying trip

runners_data.name: Lynsey Larue
runners_data.note: Recent second at 24f on soft shows she stays well and handles these conditions

races.paceDynamic: Annie Express will set a measured pace from the front with Kit's Coty and Lynsey Larue tracking prominently behind, creating a sustainable tempo that should suit the hold-up runners. The lack of genuine pace pressure means A Little Something, Moonlightinthepark and Wishful Wings can settle at the back and time their challenges, setting up a tactical finish where stamina and jumping accuracy become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Favors Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Annie Express and Kit's Coty maintain strong tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The prominent runners control the race from halfway, with their superior ratings telling as the hold-up horses struggle to close the gap. Annie Express's class advantage becomes decisive despite recent disappointing form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Time It Right
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate allowing closers to strike
scenarios.body: A Little Something and Moonlightinthepark get ideal positioning off the steady pace, with A Little Something's consistent placed form paying dividends. The 89-rated mare has the tactical speed to outkick her rivals when produced with a well-timed challenge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Kit's Coty Controls From Front
scenarios.trigger: If Kit's Coty moves up to press Annie Express early
scenarios.body: The 96-rated mare uses her prominent style to take control approaching the business end, with her recent good form and proven ability on this going giving her the edge. Her win last time out at 24f on good ground makes her ideally suited to dictate terms.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Annie Express fades badly leaving no pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy tactical affair where Lynsey Larue's recent placed form becomes valuable in a slowly-run finish. Moonlightinthepark could benefit from the lack of early pace despite her limited good going experience.

watchPoints.text: Annie Express could lead throughout if her jumping holds up but recent falls make her unreliable at the business end
Moonlightinthepark has minimal good going form so her effectiveness on today's surface is questionable
Kit's Coty's recent win came at exactly this trip and going combination making her perfectly placed
Wishful Wings tends to weaken in the closing stages which could be costly in a tactical finish
A Little Something's hold-up style suits the likely pace scenario with prominent runners setting steady tempo

races.name: Ben Chambers Memorial Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Oakley's Way
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner with strong recent form on good ground

runners_data.name: D'Jo Dela Barriere
runners_data.note: Prolific winner from rear with excellent record on similar going conditions

runners_data.name: Kates Choice
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer but lacks any wins on comparable going

runners_data.name: Jackomy
runners_data.note: Won last time on good ground from hold-up style, proven at this level

runners_data.name: Little Pi
runners_data.note: Better recent form on softer surfaces, may need rain to arrive

runners_data.name: Triple Haych
runners_data.note: Poor recent form and concerning finishing record over similar distances

races.paceDynamic: Oakley's Way will likely lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners in this small field. The pace should be sustainable and not overly demanding, which could favor the five hold-up horses who can track behind and launch finishing kicks over the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Oakley's Way gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The leader maintains stamina advantage while others struggle to reel him in from too far back. His recent winning form on good ground makes him hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and sets up a sprint finish
scenarios.body: D'Jo Dela Barriere or Jackomy time their runs perfectly from the rear of the field. The lack of early pace allows them to unleash devastating finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Oakley's Way hits the wall in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: Multiple hold-up horses converge in a blanket finish as the leader's stamina gives out. Little Pi's recent good form on softer could translate well despite the going change.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Stakes Claim
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites all disappoint or make tactical errors
scenarios.body: Triple Haych overcomes his poor recent form or Kates Choice finds improvement from a good tactical ride. The small field creates opportunities for outsiders to sneak through.

watchPoints.text: Triple Haych's tendency to fade in the finish could see him pulled up if outpaced early
Oakley's Way's jumping under pressure if others close on him in the straight
Little Pi's position turning for home as he needs to be handy to utilize any finishing kick
D'Jo Dela Barriere's trademark late move starting from the back straight
Jackomy's jumping rhythm if forced to race closer to the pace than ideal

races.name: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Your Darling
runners_data.note: Natural leader who should get uncontested tempo control with this field composition

runners_data.name: Beachcomber
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose soft ground preference may not be fully satisfied on good ground

runners_data.name: The Kalooki Kid
runners_data.note: Proven hold-up performer whose recent soft ground form suggests stamina reserves

runners_data.name: Destroytheevidence
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner with solid heavy ground form indicating stamina strength

runners_data.name: Annsam
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner but limited winning record suggests he finds one too good

runners_data.name: Lounge Lizard
runners_data.note: Hold-up to prominent runner with decent ground versatility but inconsistent recent jumping

races.paceDynamic: Your Darling will control the tempo from the front with Beachcomber, Destroytheevidence, Annsam, and Lounge Lizard all wanting prominent positions behind. This creates a moderate gallop that should suit both the pace-setters and The Kalooki Kid coming from behind. The lack of genuine front-runners means Your Darling can dictate without serious pressure until the business end.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Favours Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Your Darling gets an uncontested lead and maintains jumping rhythm
scenarios.body: Your Darling sustains the gallop turning in while the prominent runners fail to quicken decisively. The Kalooki Kid's late challenge comes too late on ground that's riding genuinely good.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Beachcomber and Destroytheevidence press Your Darling from early stages
scenarios.body: The increased tempo suits horses with tactical speed as Your Darling weakens approaching the last. Destroytheevidence's recent heavy ground form translates to stamina advantage in a strongly-run finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes steady enough for The Kalooki Kid to be within striking distance turning in
scenarios.body: The Kalooki Kid's proven finishing kick from his recent soft ground runs proves decisive in the final furlong. Your Darling and the prominent runners have done too much too soon in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from Midfield
scenarios.trigger: If Annsam or Lounge Lizard finds significant improvement stepping back up in trip
scenarios.body: One of the less-fancied prominent runners benefits from the pace scenario falling perfectly for their running style. The class horses either don't handle the ground or make crucial jumping errors under pressure.

watchPoints.text: Your Darling's jumping under pressure if Beachcomber or Destroytheevidence force the pace early
The Kalooki Kid's position turning into the straight as he needs to be within five lengths to strike
Destroytheevidence's early enthusiasm as he can be keen when prominent and waste energy
Ground conditions deteriorating which would favour The Kalooki Kid and Destroytheevidence significantly
Beachcomber's adaptation to good ground after his recent soft surface runs

races.name: Parkinsons Awareness Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: High Fibre
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who needs others to go a good gallop but has shown consistent placed efforts on similar going.

runners_data.name: Jack Hyde
runners_data.note: Highest-rated runner who races prominently and has winning form on heavy ground suggesting he handles all conditions.

runners_data.name: Roysse
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs the race to develop into a sprint but has shown decent hurdles form recently.

runners_data.name: Crest Of Stars
runners_data.note: Natural leader with recent winning form on good ground who should get an uncontested lead.

runners_data.name: D Day Arvalenreeva
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with excellent record on good ground including three wins from fifteen similar going starts.

runners_data.name: Filibustering
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has been running consistently in soft ground but may appreciate the better surface.

races.paceDynamic: Crest Of Stars as the only natural leader will control the tempo from the front without pressure, likely setting a moderate pace that could suit the closers. With three hold-up horses (High Fibre, Roysse, Filibustering) and two prominent runners (Jack Hyde, D Day Arvalenreeva), this sets up as a tactical affair where the pace could collapse in the final stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Crest Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Crest Of Stars maintains a steady gallop and keeps finding off the home turn
scenarios.body: The leader's recent good form and lack of early pressure allows him to dictate terms and kick clear. The hold-up horses struggle to make up the ground as the pace never truly collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Press
scenarios.trigger: If Jack Hyde and D Day Arvalenreeva track closer and apply pressure from the back straight
scenarios.body: Crest Of Stars gets softened up by the prominent runners before one of them kicks on. D Day Arvalenreeva's superior strike rate on good ground gives him the edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling and the race becomes a sprint from the final flight
scenarios.body: The tactical nature allows the closers to wind up and Roysse's hurdles ability shines through. High Fibre and Filibustering also benefit from the scenario but Roysse times his run better.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Crest Of Stars goes too slowly early and multiple horses make moves simultaneously turning in
scenarios.body: The race becomes a muddling affair where the best horse on the day wins rather than tactics. Jack Hyde's class advantage tells in a blanket finish where anything can happen.

watchPoints.text: Crest Of Stars must be watched for how freely he travels in front as any signs of struggle could signal the pace is too strong.
Jack Hyde's position early will be crucial as he needs to be handy but not waste energy tracking a slow pace.
D Day Arvalenreeva's jumping must be monitored as his aggressive style could lead to mistakes under pressure.
Roysse requires watching for his position at halfway as he cannot afford to be too far back in a small field.
The pace through the first mile will determine everything as too slow favors closers while honest tempo suits the leader.

races.name: Bob Cashmore & Michael Davies Open Hunters' Chase

runners_data.name: Jet Plane
runners_data.note: Class advantage but recent form patchy including two poor efforts over fences

runners_data.name: Northern Bound
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer whose style needs others to go fast enough early

runners_data.name: Fix At All
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who could benefit from tracking Jet Plane before challenging late

runners_data.name: Great Valley
runners_data.note: Limited experience but showed promise in recent softer ground efforts

runners_data.name: Missed Tee
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse competing with Northern Bound for the same tactical niche

races.paceDynamic: Jet Plane will dictate terms as the sole confirmed front runner, likely setting a manageable gallop without early pressure from this small field. Northern Bound and Missed Tee as hold-up horses will need the pace to be strong enough to set up their finishing kicks, while Fix At All and Great Valley should track Jet Plane in the early stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Jet Plane Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Jet Plane sets steady fractions and jumps cleanly throughout
scenarios.body: The class leader controls the tempo and has enough left to repel late challenges. His superior rating and front-running style prove decisive in a race lacking early pace pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Northern Bound Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes strong enough to set up his trademark finish
scenarios.body: Northern Bound gets the run of the race from the back and his proven finishing kick overwhelms tiring leaders. His excellent recent record on good ground gives him the edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fix At All Upset
scenarios.trigger: If Fix At All can maintain prominent position and outlast Jet Plane
scenarios.body: The second-string prominent runner benefits from tracking the leader before asserting late. His recent good form and tactical position prove more valuable than pure class.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Muddle
scenarios.trigger: If jumping errors or uneven pace distribution disrupts the likely pattern
scenarios.body: Poor jumping or tactical errors create opportunities for any horse adapting best to changed circumstances. Great Valley or Missed Tee could capitalize on others' misfortunes.

watchPoints.text: Jet Plane's jumping under pressure after making errors in recent chase defeats
Northern Bound getting enough pace early to enable his customary strong finish
Fix At All's position tracking Jet Plane through the early stages
Great Valley adapting from recent softer surfaces to today's good ground
Missed Tee finding room in the straight with two other hold-up horses behind leaders
